newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids drop.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids drop.

text.p: Cash bids for dark northern spring were lower at most locations Tuesday in reaction to increased farmer selling, grain dealers said.

Several dealers reported buying small quantities of wheat Tuesday, but they said farmers continued to have sizable stocks on their farms. "A lot of these guys have no major financial obligations," said a Minnesota dealer.

Farmer selling may increase in the Dakotas before roads are closed in the spring. Many roads in the Dakotas and Minnesota are closed to grain trucks and other heavy vehicles in early spring to prevent damage to road surfaces.
When the ground thaws, road surfaces become susceptible to damage from large vehicles.
